name: Meteoric-Hypostyle
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around acid rain regions, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
Standing still, you feel the scorching air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Regular pulses leave the buried megastructure aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
